name: Zero Open-Source Self-Hosted Email App
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed open-source self-hostable email application with a unified inbox, external email-provider integrations and optional AI-assisted features; no license fee or vendor-provided hosting quota for self-running the code.
watch_out: This is an email app/client, not a free hosted mailbox or SMTP delivery service. Self-hosting requires Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker and appropriate configuration; Gmail/Outlook access, Google OAuth, AI models, Cloudflare storage/workers, Twilio, Autumn or other integrations may require credentials and incur separate charges. MIT copyright/license notices apply.
